messages.text: Hi t03! LAT-10 (El Mesón de la Cava) is the very last card we need to complete La Latina. We're putting 70 P in cash on the table right now: zero fee on this venue, so every peseta of it is yours, and it settles next tick. If you'd rather settle on a different number, tell us what you have in mind and we'll look at it quickly. Thanks!
Hola! On El Rastro we sell: LAV-08 at 22 P, LAV-01 at 8 P, LAV-03 at 8 P, LAV-05 at 8 P, MAL-02 at 8 P. Send a structured offer (give cash, want card:<id>) and we talk.
